extracted.intended_audience: patrons and aspiring performers (people who attend or want to perform at Laugh Factory Chicago)
extracted.subtask_description: Venue FAQ and policy guidance for patrons, visitors, job/applicant instructions, and aspiring comedians interested in Laugh Factory Chicago (includes attendance rules, Open Mic procedure, booking/submission instructions, and staff hiring info).

rubrics_metrics.name: Age limit / ID for entry
rubrics_metrics.description: Yes. We are an 18+ venue. All guests, regardless of age, must show proof of valid photo identification for admission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptable forms of ID include State or government-issued Driver's License, State or government-issued ID, Passport, Tribal ID card, Military ID card, or a U.S. Permanent Resident or Resident Alien Card.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seating policy (first come, first served)
rubrics_metrics.description: All shows' seating is first come, first served.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regardless of your entry grouping, ALL seating is first come, first served. Please queue early in your respective group. Once the doors open, a late arrival does not guarantee seating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended queue and doors-open times
rubrics_metrics.description: The FAQ provides a chart of recommended queue start times and doors-open times based on showtime.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the published recommended queue times for your showtime (examples listed for 7:00, 7:30, 8:00, 9:00, etc.); arrive early for the best experience since seating is first come, first served.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-drink minimum requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Each guest is required to purchase at least two Laugh Factory beverage menu items during the show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drinks may be alcoholic or nonalcoholic. This policy helps pay comics and keep ticket prices low while ensuring a lively atmosphere. Please drink responsibly. You do not have to order both items at the same time; items can be ordered anytime during the show but before 'last call' and must be fulfilled by the show's end.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food service availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The club offers a light menu and attentive waitstaff will take orders and serve during the show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Menu items include boneless wings, chips and salsa, chips and guacamole, pita with hummus and veggies, french fries, and more.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cashless payments (no cash accepted)
rubrics_metrics.description: Do you accept cash? No, we do not accept cash for payment of tickets, beverages, or food.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bring an accepted card or other non-cash payment method for all purchases at the club.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unpaid bill policy / automatic gratuity
rubrics_metrics.description: Patrons forgetting to settle a bill will be charged their total amount with an added 18% gratuity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you leave without paying, the club will automatically charge the outstanding bill plus 18% gratuity.

rubrics_metrics.name: COVID-19 protocol
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not require masks or proof of vaccination for entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The club welcomes facemasks if they make you comfortable and asks patrons to be mindful of others and use hand sanitizer or wash hands often.

rubrics_metrics.name: General cancellation and transfer policy
rubrics_metrics.description: All sales are final. We do not offer refunds should you be unable to attend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you contact the club in person or by phone 24 hours before the day of your ticketed event, they will work to transfer your tickets to a future regular program (pending availability and some exclusions). Ticket transfers are limited to once per ticket order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation within 24 hours (no refunds)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you need to cancel your reservation within 24 hours of the showtime, we do not offer refunds in these circumstances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This enforces the 'all sales are final' policy for late cancellations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Club-initiated cancellation policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If the club needs to cancel a show, they will notify you and offer options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Options include rescheduling your reservation for another night or receiving a refund.

rubrics_metrics.name: Late arrival seating cutoff (30 minutes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guests are allowed into the showroom until 30 minutes after the show begins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seating stops 30 minutes into the show to prevent disruption. Latecomers are seated at the house manager's discretion and may be subject to standing room. No exceptions and no refunds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund policy (sales final except club cancellation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds. All sales are final, except in rare circumstances when the club may need to cancel the show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the club-initiated cancellation policy for refund/reschedule options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parking and arrival recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Street parking is available; public transit, ridesharing apps, and taxi services are highly encouraged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use public transit or rideshare to avoid parking hassles; plan arrival based on recommended queue times.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tickets at the door not guaranteed
rubrics_metrics.description: While the club tries to accommodate everyone, they can't guarantee tickets will be available at the door.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Buy advance tickets online to secure attendance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Camera, photo, and recording prohibition during show
rubrics_metrics.description: Take pictures before the show, but once it's started, personal cameras, selfie sticks, and other production equipment are prohibited. Cell phone calls and video or audio recordings are also prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personal photography is restricted to pre-show; respect performers and fellow patrons by not recording or taking calls during the performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bag policy and search
rubrics_metrics.description: Small bags (maximum size 12?x12?), single-compartment bags, plush bags, and purses are permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All bags are subject to search upon entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service animal policy
rubrics_metrics.description: ADA Service animals are only allowed. No pets or emotional support animals are allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only animals that meet ADA service-animal definitions are permitted inside the venue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dress code guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: We believe in creating a fun and relaxed environment; guidelines include: Wear clothes. No offensive or derogatory clothing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The club doesn't enforce particular fashion, but prohibits nudity and offensive/derogatory apparel. (Humor and free expression are welcome but should remain respectful.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of new show dates & mailing list
rubrics_metrics.description: We publish show line-ups and events several times per week.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Join the email list to get updates on upcoming or special events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Mic overview / eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Open Mic is an opportunity for aspiring comedians to take the stage and showcase their talents; it's open to anyone regardless of experience level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three Laugh Factory locations (Hollywood, San Diego, and Chicago) offer Open Mic events. Tickets are without charge to any visitor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Mic sign-up and bucket draw procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: In Chicago, a professional comedian hosts Open Mic and the first 10 names drawn from our bucket get a 3-minute set; all others will participate in a random draw for a spot on next week's mic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To sign up, arrive at 7:00 PM to enter the bucket draw and potentially receive a spot on the mic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Mic performance expectations (prepared vs. improvisation)
rubrics_metrics.description: You do not necessarily need a prepared act to perform at an Open Mic event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some performers have prepared routines, others improvise or try new material — it's about having fun and being creative; Open Mic can lead to future regular line-up opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Mic schedule (Chicago)
rubrics_metrics.description: Laugh Factory Chicago's Open Mic is held Tuesday at 9:15 PM; doors open at 9:00 PM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Open Mic information page for details and other locations' schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Space rental inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: We rent our space for special events, fundraisers, or private parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email info@laughfactory.com with details about the desired event and the team will respond.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to apply for jobs at Laugh Factory
rubrics_metrics.description: You may look for open positions on Indeed by searching for Laugh Factory and the venue city, check the careers page, or drop by the club during show hours and ask for an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You won't be asked to tell jokes during an interview. Positions range from servers to administrative roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hiring criteria / desired employee qualities
rubrics_metrics.description: The club seeks team members with a positive attitude, excellent customer service skills, and a willingness to learn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prior comedy club experience is not required. Bonus points if you have a good sense of humor. Benefits include flexible schedules, competitive wages, and networking opportunities with comedians.

rubrics_metrics.name: How comedians get booked
rubrics_metrics.description: If you want to be booked at Laugh Factory, please send an email and professional resume to info@laughfactory.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The club also advises aspiring performers to attend Open Mic events as a starting point for getting on regular line-ups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitting content to Laugh Factory website
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your best content, jokes, photos, or videos to become an exclusive Laugh Factory member and have your content shared on our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the site's submission mechanism — content may be reviewed by site staff ('Doctors of the Soul') for posting and membership consideration.
